content.text:
I recommend one period control on rankings, MP pages and funder pages, in the same position below the heading and identity metadata and above the figures. Use three linked segments labelled “Historical”, “This parliamentary term” and “This year”. Default to this parliamentary term so rankings retain their present default.

| Period | Registration dates included |
| --- | --- |
| Historical | All stored records, including undated declarations |
| This parliamentary term | On or after 9 July 2024 at 00:00 UTC |
| This year | From 1 January at 00:00 UTC until the following 1 January, exclusive |

“This year” should mean the full UTC calendar year, matching the existing totals definition. It should not silently mean year to date. Dates describe registration, not when funding changed hands.

Existing behavior differs between pages. Rankings currently select only the parliamentary term, aggregate eligible declarations and then select the top ten. MP rankings include all categories, while funder and party rankings include donation and support declarations. Those category differences should remain explicit in the design. Selecting the same period would not make a funder’s ranking amount equal its detail-page total. See [rankings service](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/services/rankings.rs:51).

Detail pages already receive three authoritative totals and display them together. I recommend displaying the selected period as one declared GBP headline, while retaining all three mandatory backend totals. The frontend should select the corresponding field without calculating a replacement. The existing contract lives in [DeclaredGbpTotals](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:245), and the current presentation is in [DeclaredTotals](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/DeclaredTotals.svelte:24).

The selected period should govern the whole data view. Apply it to declared amounts, declaration and funding-entry counts, category and source charts, funder recipient and party charts, and history entries. Identity metadata stays unchanged. Keep existing custom date controls within history as an additional refinement of the selected period. Changing periods should clear those dates and reset pagination, preventing an old date range from producing a misleading empty view.

Store the selection in `period=historical|current-term|current-year`. Preserve it across category changes, summary/history navigation and links between rankings, MPs and funders. Category remains an independent URL parameter. Existing [entity navigation helpers](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:151) currently preserve the search context and would need to carry this state too. Native links with `aria-current="page"` would support keyboard use, bookmarking and opening another view in a new tab.

For implementation, introduce one canonical `ReportingPeriod` enum that resolves a registration window with inclusive start, exclusive end and an explicit undated-record rule. Capture the current year once per backend request. Filter records before aggregation and ranking. A shared presentation-only link component should own neutral styling and wrapping on small screens; features should own URLs and period interpretation.

Acceptance checks should cover exact term and year boundaries, undated records, navigation persistence, pagination resets, keyboard operation and mobile wrapping. Preserve exact decimals, currencies, unknown categories, incomplete-total flags, null versus zero, and declaration versus funding-entry counts. These are proposed changes; no implementation was made.
